purpose: Qualify evidence for one bounded trajectory segment using caller-frozen equation-cohort policies.

vlasov_poisson_pic.notes: Only require energy and field observables that match the selected solver discretization, boundary treatment and normalization. MMD accepts signed measures; balanced W1 accepts nonnegative equal-mass measures.

vlasov_maxwell_pic.notes: Record the actual discrete Gauss and div(B) constraints, charge-conserving deposition/current correction, Poynting flux and boundary work. Momentum applicability depends on the discretization and boundaries.

collisional_vlasov_maxwell_landau.notes: Entropy production is collision-model and discretization-specific. Do not impose collisionless entropy conservation on a collisional model.

reduced_quasineutral_vlasov_ampere.notes: Only require constraints and asymptotic properties proved for the reduced equations. Do not inherit full-Maxwell gates without proof.

provenance_rules.run_identity: All observations for the same trajectory must agree on run_id, input_digest and config_digest.
provenance_rules.independent_sources: Each metric observation retains its own source_revision and operator_id; diagnostic implementations are allowed to be independently versioned.
provenance_rules.error_budget: All components must share run identity and segment, while retaining separate per-component source receipts.

qualification.pass: Applicable deterministic or probabilistic upper error bound is no greater than the exact tolerance frozen in the cohort policy.
qualification.fail: Applicable lower error bound is strictly greater than the frozen tolerance.
qualification.unresolved: Missing values, empirical-only evidence, tolerance overlap, unavailable data, stale provenance or policy mismatch.
qualification.not_applicable: Explicitly reasoned not-applicable metric, retained only when the cohort policy permits it.
qualification.fail_closed: Missing, non-finite, stale, under-specified or incomparable evidence never becomes zero and never passes.

error_budget.permitted: Conservative upper-bound sum for identical cohort, target metric, units, time segment and provenance.
error_budget.probabilistic: Sum upper bounds and use confidence lower bound 1 - sum(1 - confidence_i), i.e. a union bound without independence.
error_budget.root_sum_square: Not implemented; requires a separately verified covariance/independence contract.

claim_limits: This schema and evaluator do not create physical error bounds.
An upper bound is only as valid as its operator, norm, discretization, boundary, arithmetic and derivation assumptions.
A probabilistic confidence level is retained and combined only by a union bound.
The error-budget sum is meaningful only when every component bounds the same target quantity in the same norm and units.
No generic cross-cohort score or universal tolerance is implied.
